ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $\angle ACB=90^\circ$, $AC=4$, and $BC=3$, with $CD$ being the altitude of $\triangle ABC$. What is the value of $\tan\angle BCD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} In $\triangle ABC$ and $\triangle BCD$, $\angle A + \angle B = 90^\circ$, $\angle BCD + \angle B = 90^\circ$.\\
$\therefore \angle A = \angle BCD$.\\
$\therefore \tan \angle BCD = \tan A = \frac{BC}{AC} = \boxed{\frac{3}{4}}$
